newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC edges higher after 1996 report.
newsitem.headline: SBC edges higher after 1996 report.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp's share price rose 3.50 Swiss francs to stand at 306.50 at 0955 GMT after the group reported an expected net loss of 1.955 billion francs.
The SMI blue-chip index was 0.45 percent higher at 4,698.0
SBC reported that its gross operating profit was up 29 percent to 3.905 billion francs and its after-tax profit before extraordinary items was up 26 percent to 1.328 billion.
In addition, SBC also said it was confident of making further progress in 1997 toward its medium-term target of an after-tax return on equity of 15 percent.
